summary:
We develop a temperature trend analysis that depends of environment elements like __ .
By working on this project we able to understand the significance of this challenge and the vast use cases of these raw data sets.
As we all know Global warming is a important problem there exist without a proper solution. So we think that buy understanding different elements influence in temperature should be significant.
details:
We downloaded Time-series Area averaged data from Giovanni website for a specific region. we build a python program to find the temperature trend using data such as 2-meter specific humidity, 2-meter air temperature - daily mean, Total surface precipitation, 10-meter eastward wind, 10-meter northward wind, Surface incoming shortwave flux & surface pressure.

By running the python program the tend data, plot will be visible in an output folder.
